headline: Nigeria Q2 Portfolio Investment Inflows Surge 17.6% to $7.09 Billion
summary: Nigeria's portfolio investment inflows rose 17.6% quarter-on-quarter to $7.09 billion in the second quarter of 2026, according to the Central Bank of Nigeria, while direct investment lagged.
why: Foreign capital inflows are essential for stabilizing the Nigerian naira and financing external payments following monetary policy tightening.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Rising portfolio inflows improve dollar liquidity and help support external currency reserves.
